author: nself
description: MinIO compatibility service for projects that already store data in the core MinIO volume. Keeps the minio service name and the minio_data volume under v1.5, so existing objects stay readable through S3. New projects use the core SeaweedFS store.

envVars.description: Root user of the MinIO server. Read from the project .env or .env.secrets; falls back to minioadmin, the core default.
envVars.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER

envVars.description: Root password of the MinIO server. Read from .env.secrets through .nself/compose.env; falls back to minioadmin, the core default. Keep the value the data was created with.
envVars.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD

envVars.description: Comma-separated buckets MinIO creates at start when missing; default uploads,public,private,temp (the core default).
envVars.name: MINIO_DEFAULT_BUCKETS

envVars.description: Host port of the S3 API, published on 127.0.0.1 only; default 9000.
envVars.name: MINIO_PORT

envVars.description: Host port of the MinIO console, published on 127.0.0.1 only; default 9001.
envVars.name: MINIO_CONSOLE_PORT

name: minio
